metadata.dcterms:title: A Tannakian description of the local Kaletha gerbe
metadata.dcterms:creator: MELI, ALEXANDER BERTOLONI
DILLERY, PETER
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We construct, for a p-adic field F, an explicit semisimple Tannakian category RigIsocF whose category of fiber functors recovers Kaletha’s Galois gerbe EKal. We then classify and write down the simple objects in RigIsocF , all of which come from elliptic twisted Levi subgroups of GLn.
